titulo.es: Nato to ‘urgently’ get air defences for Ukraine, as Zelenskyy warns of surge in Russian missile production
titulo.en: Nato to ‘urgently’ get air defences for Ukraine, as Zelenskyy warns of surge in Russian missile production

sintesis.es: After Ukraine failed to shoot down a single ballistic missile fired by Russia on Wednesday, the president urged allies to increase supplies of Patriot interceptors Nato is working to get Ukraine the air defences it “urgently needs”, its secretary general has said, after Kyiv failed to shoot down a single Russian missile in an attack on Wednesday, and as Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that Moscow was seeking to significantly boost missile ⁠production ahead of winter. Speaking at a National Security and Defense Council meeting on winter resilience, the Ukrainian president did not rule out the idea that stalling missile supplies from western allies were “aimed at making Ukraine, so to speak, more willing to compromise” in peace talks with Russia. titulo.es: Drone carrying explosives at German airport marks ‘new level of danger’, says interior minister
titulo.en: Drone carrying explosives at German airport marks ‘new level of danger’, says interior minister

sintesis.es: Investigators treating incident as part of ‘professional hybrid threat scenario’, says Alexander Dobrindt • The Leipzig drone bomb marks a dangerous escalation for Europe Germany’s interior minister has warned that the discovery of a drone carrying explosives at Leipzig airport marks “a new level of danger” for the country, as authorities examine whether the thwarted attack could have been planned by a foreign power. The discovery of a small drone carrying explosives at Leipzig airport, a leading shipping and military hub, set off alarm and caused flight diversions on Wednesday morning. German police deployed a bomb disposal robot to defuse and destroy the explosive device.

titulo.es: Rusia intensifica ataques con misiles y drones sobre Kiev con al menos 21 muertos; UE responde con ayuda financiera a Ucrania
titulo.en: Russia intensifies missile and drone attacks on Kyiv leaving at least 21 dead; EU responds with financial aid to Ukraine

sintesis.es: Rusia lanzó un intenso bombardeo con misiles y drones sobre Kiev y sus alrededores, dejando al menos 21 muertos y decenas de heridos, con almacenes como principales objetivos. Ucrania denunció además ataques deliberados contra civiles, como la persecución con drones a un vendedor en Jersón. En respuesta, la Unión Europea anunció 1.400 millones de euros para Ucrania financiados con activos rusos inmovilizados, mientras se reportan casos de soldados heridos rusos reenviados al frente sin las evaluaciones médicas requeridas.
sintesis.en: Russia launched an intense missile and drone bombardment on Kyiv and surrounding areas, leaving at least 21 dead and dozens injured, with warehouses as main targets. Ukraine also denounced deliberate attacks on civilians, such as a drone chase against a vendor in Kherson. In response, the European Union announced 1.4 billion euros for Ukraine funded by frozen Russian assets, while reports emerged of wounded Russian soldiers being sent back to the front without required medical evaluations.

titulo.es: Netanyahu rechaza el plan de EE.UU. para Gaza mientras Israel intensifica bombardeos y construye barreras internas
titulo.en: Netanyahu rejects US plan for Gaza as Israel intensifies strikes and builds internal barriers

sintesis.es: Israel cuestionó y finalmente rechazó el plan estadounidense impulsado por Trump para el desarme de Hamás y la retirada israelí de Gaza, pese a que Hamás había anunciado su disposición a desarmarse. Netanyahu afirmó que el ejército no se retirará hasta el desarme completo, mientras Israel intensificó los bombardeos, causando decenas de muertos y afectando escuelas, y expertos señalan movimientos de tierra que sugieren una frontera interna permanente en la Franja. Naciones Unidas advirtió que Gaza sigue siendo insegura para los civiles pese al alto el fuego de octubre.
sintesis.en: Israel questioned and ultimately rejected the US-backed plan pushed by Trump for Hamas disarmament and an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza, despite Hamas announcing willingness to disarm. Netanyahu stated the army would not withdraw until full disarmament, as Israel intensified airstrikes, killing dozens and hitting schools, while experts point to earthworks suggesting a permanent internal border in the Strip. The UN warned Gaza remains unsafe for civilians despite the October ceasefire.

titulo.es: Mexican influencer shot dead while streaming live on social media
titulo.en: Mexican influencer shot dead while streaming live on social media

sintesis.es: César Gastélum was filming outside a fast-food outlet in Sinaloa state when he was killed by a motorbike driver A popular Mexican influencer has been shot dead while doing a live stream on social media outside a restaurant in Sinaloa state, where lethal cartel violence has become widespread. César Gastélum, who had nearly 600,000 followers on TikTok and was known for making comedy videos, was filming with two friends outside a fast-food restaurant in the city of Culiacán. The three were dressed in the bright orange jackets and backpacks of food delivery drivers.

titulo.es: Scientists reveal the hidden force driving the universe’s hottest fluid
titulo.en: Scientists reveal the hidden force driving the universe’s hottest fluid

sintesis.es: When atomic nuclei smash together at nearly the speed of light, they create the hottest fluid in the universe, but scientists may have overlooked one of its most important forces. New simulations reveal that extreme acceleration builds up along the edges of quark-gluon plasma, helping drive its explosive expansion. This acceleration may do far more than move the fluid, potentially changing its temperature-like behavior, influencing particle spins, and even reshaping how matter transitions between fundamental states.
